user.title: Battery storage
user.description: Speicherwacht reads the counters of your battery (energy charged and discharged, lifetime) and its state of charge from their long-term statistics. Pick a detected storage or map the entities yourself.

data_description.name: Name of the device Speicherwacht creates.
data_description.source: Templates marked (beta) were built from the integration's source code and are not yet confirmed on a real installation.

user_hint_anker_solix.title: Battery storage
user_hint_anker_solix.description:
Speicherwacht reads the counters of your battery (energy charged and discharged, lifetime) and its state of charge from their long-term statistics. Pick a detected storage or map the entities yourself.

Anker SOLIX: a Solarbank was found without lifetime counters. They come only by MQTT with the owner account, and the integration leaves them out until you allow the energy category: Anker SOLIX → Configure → remove 'solarbank_energy' from the excluded categories, enable MQTT.

data_description.name: Name of the device Speicherwacht creates.
data_description.source: Templates marked (beta) were built from the integration's source code and are not yet confirmed on a real installation.

entities.title: Entities and capacity
entities.description: Counters need a state class (total or total_increasing), the state of charge the state class measurement: Speicherwacht works from their long-term statistics, including the time before the setup.

data_description.charged: Energy into the battery. Only power in W? Create a counter with the helper 'Integral' (left Riemann sum).
data_description.capacity: From the data sheet (usable, not gross). Needed for the state of charge correction and full cycles; the estimated capacity never replaces it.
data_description.boundary: Results of the two boundaries are not comparable.
data_description.warranty_mwh: Energy the warranty covers, in MWh discharged (data sheet or warranty terms). Adds the sensor 'Warranted throughput used'.

error.counter_in_use: This charge counter already belongs to another Speicherwacht entry.
error.day_counter: A counter fell back several times in the last days: it looks like a day counter (energy today). Speicherwacht needs lifetime counters (total energy).
error.soc_unit: The state of charge must be in %.
error.soc_statistics: The state of charge has no long-term statistics (state class measurement missing).
error.energy_unit: Counters must be in Wh, kWh or MWh.
error.counter_statistics: A counter has no long-term statistics (state class total or total_increasing missing).

abort.already_configured: This storage is already set up.

options.battery: the battery (DC, e.g. inverter battery counters)
options.system: the whole storage (AC, e.g. a plug meter in front of it)

counter_resets.title: Speicherwacht: counter starts anew again and again
counter_resets.description: These counters of {name} started anew at least 3 times in the last 7 days: {entities}. That is how a day counter (energy today) behaves; Speicherwacht then counts too little. Choose lifetime counters (total energy) under Settings → Devices & services → Speicherwacht → ⋮ → Reconfigure.

missing_entity.title: Speicherwacht: entity missing
missing_entity.description: These entities of {name} do not exist: {entities}. Choose others under Settings → Devices & services → Speicherwacht → ⋮ → Reconfigure.

source_unavailable.title: Speicherwacht: source not available
source_unavailable.description: These entities of {name} have been unavailable for more than {minutes} minutes: {entities}. Speicherwacht lacks values meanwhile. Check the source integration. The issue disappears once values arrive again.

source_unit.title: Speicherwacht: unexpected unit
source_unit.description: These entities of {name} have a unit Speicherwacht cannot use (counters Wh/kWh/MWh, state of charge %): {entities}. Choose others under Reconfigure.
